title: OpenBao audit investigation
description: OpenBao audit investigation. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. Native alert parity is not mapped. See the profile validation record for tested environments.

options.query:
`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(operation,"^(create|update|delete)$") AND match(request_path,"^sys/audit(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(operation,"^(create|update|delete)$") AND match(request_path,"^sys/audit(/|$)")
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where audit_type="response" AND len(mvjoin(audit_error,""))>0
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller audit_error

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where audit_type="response" AND len(mvjoin(audit_error,""))>0
| stats count AS response_errors

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(request_path,"^(auth/|sys/auth/)")
| stats count AS audit_events

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(request_path,"^(auth/|sys/auth/)")
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| stats count AS audit_events

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| timechart span=5m count BY host limit=10 useother=t

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(request_path,"^sys/(auth|audit|mounts|policies|raw|plugins|storage/raft|rotate)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?is)(permission denied|forbidden)") AND (audit_type="response" OR (audit_type="request" AND match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?i)^forbidden$")))
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?is)(permission denied|forbidden)") AND (audit_type="response" OR (audit_type="request" AND match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?i)^forbidden$")))
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(operation,"^(create|update|delete)$") AND match(request_path,"^sys/(policies|auth|mounts)(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(operation,"^(create|update|delete)$") AND match(request_path,"^sys/(auth|audit|mounts|policies|raw|plugins|storage/raft|rotate)")
| timechart span=5m count BY host limit=10 useother=t

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(operation,"^(create|update|delete)$") AND match(request_path,"^sys/(auth|audit|mounts|policies|raw|plugins|storage/raft|rotate)")
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| where match(operation,"^(create|update|delete)$") AND match(request_path,"^sys/(auth|audit|mounts|policies|raw|plugins|storage/raft|rotate)")

viz_audit_configuration_activity.title: Audit config changes
viz_audit_configuration_activity.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_audit_configuration_events.title: Audit config events
viz_audit_configuration_events.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_audit_error_events.title: Response error events
viz_audit_error_events.description: Recent response errors, with only allowlisted metadata. OpenBao audit error text can be HMAC-protected; this is not a complete operational error log.

viz_audit_response_errors.title: Response errors
viz_audit_response_errors.description: Response entries with a nonempty top-level error in the selected time range. Does not infer an HTTP status from the audit payload.

viz_auth_activity.title: Auth activity
viz_auth_activity.description: Audit entries for authentication and token paths in the selected time range. Includes request and response entries.

viz_auth_activity_events.title: Auth activity events
viz_auth_activity_events.description: Recent authentication and token metadata. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access; wrapping requests can omit these fields.

viz_filtered_audit_events.title: Filtered audit events
viz_filtered_audit_events.description: Audit entries in the selected time range. Request and response entries are separate events; this is not a unique API request count.

viz_filtered_audit_events_by_node.title: Filtered events by node
viz_filtered_audit_events_by_node.description: Audit event volume by Splunk host in the selected time range. Configure host as the emitting OpenBao node during ingestion.

viz_filtered_audit_stream.title: Filtered audit stream
viz_filtered_audit_stream.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_high_risk_system_path_activity.title: High-risk sys paths
viz_high_risk_system_path_activity.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_permission_denied_events.title: Permission denied events
viz_permission_denied_events.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_permission_denied_responses.title: Permission denied
viz_permission_denied_responses.description: Audit entries whose visible error text matches permission denied or forbidden. HMAC-protected errors cannot be classified by this query. This is not an HTTP status count.

viz_privileged_configuration_mutations.title: Privileged config changes
viz_privileged_configuration_mutations.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_request_id_drilldown.title: Request ID drilldown
viz_request_id_drilldown.description: Recent allowlisted request metadata. Use the request ID filter for correlation; matching entries do not establish end-to-end request duration. Credential and secret payload fields are omitted.

viz_risky_system_activity_by_node.title: Risky sys activity by node
viz_risky_system_activity_by_node.description: High-risk system mutation entries by emitting host in the selected time range.

viz_risky_system_events.title: Risky sys events
viz_risky_system_events.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_risky_system_mutations.title: Risky sys mutations
viz_risky_system_mutations.description: Audit entries for create, update, or delete operations on high-risk system paths in the selected time range. Activity is not proof of unauthorized behavior.
